questions.question: What is the primary idea behind Edge AI?
options: Training models only in cloud data centers
Running AI models directly on local devices

questions.question: Which of the following is an example of an edge device?
A major advantage of Edge AI is:
Why is Edge AI useful in autonomous vehicles?
options: Decisions can be made immediately without cloud delays

questions.question: Which statement best describes Federated Learning?
options: All data is collected in one central location
Models are trained without any data
Multiple devices train a shared model without sharing raw data
Only cloud servers participate in learning

questions.question: The core philosophy of Federated Learning is:
options: The model moves to the data

questions.question: In Federated Learning, what is typically shared with the central server?
What is the purpose of Federated Averaging (FedAvg)?
options: Average updates received from participating clients

questions.question: Which challenge is commonly faced in Federated Learning?
What does Non-IID data mean in Federated Learning?
options: Data distributions differ significantly across clients

questions.question: What is the primary goal of Privacy-Preserving Learning?
options: Learn useful patterns while protecting sensitive information

questions.question: Which of the following is a privacy risk in machine learning?
Differential Privacy protects individuals primarily by:
Homomorphic Encryption allows:
Secure Multi-Party Computation (SMPC) enables:
Which statement correctly compares Edge AI and Cloud AI?
options: Edge AI processes data locally while Cloud AI processes data remotely
Edge AI has unlimited computing resources

questions.question: A smartphone performs face recognition entirely on-device without sending images to the cloud. This is an example of:
A hospital wants to collaborate with other hospitals to improve a disease prediction model without sharing patient records. Which approach is most suitable?
Which concept describes the balance between protecting privacy and maintaining model performance?
Which sequence best represents a privacy-aware AI system?
options: Collect all data → Ignore privacy → Train model
Design privacy protections → Protect data → Train model → Deploy responsibly
